title: sample: spawn or attach, tick at an interval, keep stamped snapshots
body: run spawns the command as a child so tick zero is its start and its exit is exact, and reads wait4 rusage for the whole tree at the end. attach takes a pid and stops when it is gone. Each snapshot is stamped with an Instant. The interval is a flag with a default of 100 ms; the probe over 48 threads is well under a millisecond, so the cost is the parse.
